domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's request for leave of a specific type, tracking its full lifecycle from draft through approval/rejection to cancellation.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT — request created but not yet submitted for review
SUBMITTED — request has been submitted and is pending manager action
APPROVED — manager has approved the request; leave balance has been deducted
REJECTED — manager has rejected the request; no balance impact
CANCELLED — request was withdrawn by the employee (from DRAFT, SUBMITTED, or APPROVED); if previously APPROVED, balance is restored

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, usage, and remaining balance for a specific leave policy within a fiscal year.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — balance is in effect for the current fiscal year; accruals and deductions apply
EXHAUSTED — remainingDays has reached zero; no further leave of this type can be taken until next accrual or fiscal year reset
FROZEN — balance is temporarily suspended (e.g., employee on long-term leave, investigation); no deductions or accruals
CLOSED — fiscal year has ended; balance is archived and a new balance for the next fiscal year is created

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific category of leave (annual, sick, emergency, etc.), including accrual behavior, notice requirements, and approval mandates.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — policy is in effect; employees can request leave under this policy
INACTIVE — policy has been deactivated; no new requests accepted, existing approved leave unaffected

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each type maps to a LeavePolicy that governs its rules. The feature explicitly requires annual, sick, and emergency; unpaid, maternity, and paternity are defined for completeness.

business_rules: BR-001 — Leave Balance Sufficiency: Before a LeaveRequest transitions from DRAFT to SUBMITTED, the system must verify that the employee's LeaveBalance for the corresponding LeavePolicy has remainingDays >= the number of calendar days requested (endDate - startDate + 1). If insufficient, the submission must be rejected with a clear error.

BR-002 — Manager Approval Requirement: If the LeavePolicy governing the request has requiresManagerApproval = true, the LeaveRequest must be acted upon by the employee's manager (Employee.managerId). Only a user with the manager role who is the designated manager of that employee may approve or reject. If requiresManagerApproval = false, the request auto-approves on submission.
